title: Three Times the Price
staging:
Scene 05 — Three Times the Price

04:00–05:00 · 60 sec · 7-Catleven freezer aisle

Only two packages of salmon remain. A notice says prices have increased threefold. Byte scans the price history and finds the increase began before the emergency broadcast.

Shots: Freezer aisle wide → two lonely salmon packs → price notice → Byte's handheld scanner → Trixie's shocked reaction.

lines.speaker: Byte
lines.text: Thirty bucks for a piece of fish? Last week it was ten!

takes.title: S05-D01-byte-take001
takes.text: Thirty bucks for a piece of fish? Last week it was ten!

lines.speaker: Trixie
lines.text: Check the price history. When did it change?

takes.title: S05-D02-trixie-take001
takes.text: Check the price history. When did it change?

lines.speaker: Byte
lines.text: Before the broadcast. They raised it before anyone knew there was an emergency.

takes.title: S05-D03-byte-take001
takes.text: Before the broadcast. They raised it before anyone knew there was an emergency.

lines.speaker: Trixie
lines.text: They knew. We were the last ones told.

takes.title: S05-D04-trixie-take001
takes.text: They knew. We were the last ones told.

lines.speaker: Byte
lines.text: Two packs left. At this price, we can afford to look at one.

takes.title: S05-D05-byte-take001
takes.text: Two packs left. At this price, we can afford to look at one.

lines.speaker: Byte
lines.text: Well, it is working. I am panicking.

takes.title: S05-D07-byte-take001
takes.text: Well, it is working. I am panicking.

lines.speaker: Trixie
lines.text: Save the timestamp. And the old price. We need something people can check.

takes.title: S05-D08-trixie-take001
takes.text: Save the timestamp. And the old price. We need something people can check.

lines.speaker: Byte
lines.text: Done. Apparently dinner now comes with an investigation.

takes.title: S05-D09-byte-take001
takes.text: Done. Apparently dinner now comes with an investigation.

lines.speaker: Trixie
lines.text: We are going to tell the whole district.

takes.title: S05-D10-trixie-take001
takes.text: We are going to tell the whole district.
